title: Unveiling Covert Toxicity in Multimodal Data via Toxicity Association Graphs: A Graph-Based Metric and Interpretable Detection Framework
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on detecting covert toxicity in multimodal data across categories like drugs, crimes, violence, and hate, without specifying a religious context.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
